question: Should Browser CLI permanently reject valid `--fields-file` JSON arrays above 1 MiB for all existing users?
rationale: Current behavior accepted any readable valid file, while this branch creates a new public runtime rejection; choosing that compatibility policy requires owner intent rather than a mechanical code change.

options.title: Adopt the 1 MiB contract
options.body: Confirm that bounded memory use outweighs compatibility with larger existing descriptor files, then merge with the documented limit as the supported CLI behavior.

options.title: Preserve current compatibility
options.body: Do not add a universal rejection limit until a compatible product path or a separately approved migration/design is available.

recommendation.title: Adopt the 1 MiB contract
recommendation.body: Confirm that bounded memory use outweighs compatibility with larger existing descriptor files, then merge with the documented limit as the supported CLI behavior.
